controls.label: Shape model
controls.description: An approximate ellipsoid based on the 10.6 × 6.0 × 5.3 km dimensions presented by Porter and colleagues in 2025. New Horizons resolved only a few pixels across Styx, so the grid marks unavailable surface coverage. The spin pole remains uncertain; lighting shows the modeled shape.
controls.title: Approximate shape model
controls.summary: Shape estimated from New Horizons images that resolve only a few pixels. The pole is uncertain; gray grid: no imagery.
